props.name: onClose
props.description: Called when the dialog should close — after the discard question, if there are unsaved changes.

props.name: title
props.description: Visible title in the header. Becomes the accessible name.

props.name: actionLabel
props.description: Label on the header's primary action — "Save", "Send". Omit for no action.

props.name: actionDisabled
props.description: Blocks the primary action, e.g. while the form is invalid.

props.name: actionLoading
props.description: Shows the primary action as working.

props.name: mode
props.description: responsive fills the screen below 640px and is a tall centred sheet above; always fills it everywhere.

props.name: dirty
props.description: There are unsaved changes. Closing asks before throwing them away.

props.name: discardDescription
props.defaultValue: 'You have changes that have not been saved. They will be lost.'

props.name: discardLabel
props.description: Label on the button that throws the changes away.

props.name: footer
props.description: Optional footer, pinned under the body.
